description: The signed-in couple's own wedding budget on Zola: mark 1 scheduled payment as paid. Get the payment_id and its version from zola_get_my_budget first. No money moves: Zola only records the payment. Give paid_on, the day that the couple paid in her time zone: ask her if you do not know it. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Status: preview, nothing_to_change (the payment is paid already), done, draft_changed or record_changed (the payment changed: show the new preview and ask again). Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

paid_on.description: The day that the couple paid, YYYY-MM-DD, in the time zone of the couple. Not after today. Ask the couple if you do not know it

version.description: The version of the payment from zola_get_my_budget. A change of the payment after that read stops the preview

name: zola_mark_my_vendor_payment_paid

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a payment marked paid in the budget of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the budget

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_mark_my_vendor_payment_paid with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The payments with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_get_my_budget gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

removal_count.description: the changes that overwrite a day of payment

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Mark My Vendor Payment Paid
